question: Which pre-signal semantic subgroups of the legacy multiscale high-tight-flag pool explain the negative fixed-40-day Alpha, and do any subgroups preserve right-tail recall?
method: Re-derived the exact archived detector at each trade's signal date from source.zip; no parameter, data, or exit changes. Post-hoc decomposition of the frozen v2 training ledger only.
detector_reconciliation: 1242 of 1245 trades reproduce executable status; 3 differ due to valid-bar window edge cases (0.24 percent). No material effect on conclusions.
interpretation: The negative bulk is not uniform: short-scale flags are negative in every pole-gain and depth slice, and pole gain at or above 1.5 is negative in every scale.

Medium and long scale flags with pole gain below 1.5 are approximately Alpha-neutral to slightly positive, and together retain the majority of right-tail hits (278 of 483 paths above 20 percent MFE; 63 of 117 above 50 percent).

Excluding short-scale candidates removes 41 percent of the pool and essentially the entire negative bulk, leaving a roughly Alpha-neutral medium/long pool with preserved majority right-tail recall. It does not by itself create a positive-Alpha strategy.

pre_registered_hypothesis.change: Restrict the executable flag pool to medium and long scales; exclude short-scale flags from entry.
pre_registered_hypothesis.mechanism: Sub-60-bar short flags are too short to filter post-pole reversion; they are the dominant negative-bulk contributor across all pole-gain and depth states.
pre_registered_hypothesis.unchanged: Detector thresholds, exits, stop, costs, universe, and the 2016-2022 training boundary.
pre_registered_hypothesis.test: Run a frozen full-candidate training baseline with the same protocol and default exits; register success only if mean 40-day excess is nonnegative and mean fixed-horizon Alpha is nonnegative in at least four training years while preserving the majority of 50-percent-MFE paths.
pre_registered_hypothesis.not_authorized: Parameter grid searches, temporal-test inspection, or reusing the 2023-2026 exposed period as a clean holdout.

next_action: Pre-register and run the single scale-restriction baseline only after the current cup and wide-VCP runs finish; do not launch a third concurrent research run.
